subject.title: [Feature]: Auto‑forward images from Node agent.request to IM users when deliver: true

question: Should Node-originated `agent.request` attachments be allowed to auto-relay to credentialed IM recipients, and if so what explicit opt-in, authorization, media-limit, audit, and agent-override semantics are required?
rationale: This changes a gateway-to-channel trust boundary and the current agent-controlled delivery contract, so code inspection cannot safely choose the permanent behavior without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design explicit opt-in relay
options.body: Add a protocol field only after defining route authorization, size/type limits, audit metadata, and how agent-authored media suppresses or replaces forwarded attachments.

options.title: Keep agent-controlled delivery
options.body: Reject auto-forwarding on `agent.request` and document direct `send` or message-tool media delivery for dumb relay workflows.

options.title: Add automatic fallback forwarding
options.body: Append original attachments whenever the agent emits no media, accepting a broader trust-boundary change and changed suppression semantics.

recommendation.title: Design explicit opt-in relay
recommendation.body: Add a protocol field only after defining route authorization, size/type limits, audit metadata, and how agent-authored media suppresses or replaces forwarded attachments.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway node-dispatch and agent delivery history makes this the strongest routing candidate for the boundary decision.
